_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "places" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_alt" TEXT NULL, "place_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'village', "parent_place_id" TEXT NULL, "pincode" TEXT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "people" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "full_name_alt" TEXT NULL, "nickname" TEXT NULL, "surname" TEXT NULL, "gender" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "is_living" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("is_living" IN (0, 1)), "birth_year" INTEGER NULL, "birth_month" INTEGER NULL, "birth_day" INTEGER NULL, "birth_date_approx" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("birth_date_approx" IN (0, 1)), "birth_order" INTEGER NULL, "death_year" INTEGER NULL, "death_month" INTEGER NULL, "death_day" INTEGER NULL, "birth_place_id" TEXT NULL, "native_place_id" TEXT NULL, "gotra" TEXT NULL, "occupation" TEXT NULL, "organization" TEXT NULL, "designation" TEXT NULL, "education" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_self" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_self" IN (0, 1)), "is_placeholder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_placeholder" IN (0, 1)), "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "notify_birthday" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("notify_birthday" IN (0, 1)), "merged_into_id" TEXT NULL, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person_names" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'alias', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person_contacts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_value" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "is_whatsapp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_whatsapp" IN (0, 1)), "is_primary" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_primary" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person_addresses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'home', "address_line" TEXT NULL, "place_id" TEXT NULL, "pincode" TEXT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "is_primary" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_primary" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person_attributes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parent_child" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "parent_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "child_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'biological', "certainty" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed', "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "partnerships" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "person_a_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_b_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'marriage', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "start_year" INTEGER NULL, "start_month" INTEGER NULL, "start_day" INTEGER NULL, "start_date_approx" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("start_date_approx" IN (0, 1)), "end_year" INTEGER NULL, "place_id" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "social_connections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "other_person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "connection_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "since_year" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "family_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_alt" TEXT NULL, "gotra" TEXT NULL, "kuldevta" TEXT NULL, "native_place_id" TEXT NULL, "head_person_id" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "family_group_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "family_group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person_merges" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "survivor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "merged_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_alt" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person_tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "interactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "title" TEXT NULL, "interaction_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in_person', "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "place_id" TEXT NULL, "location_text" TEXT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "follow_up_on" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "interaction_participants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "interaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'participant', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "person_id" TEXT NULL, "interaction_id" TEXT NULL, "reminder_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'follow_up', "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "recurrence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "notes" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "person_id" TEXT NULL, "interaction_id" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "sha256" TEXT NULL, "caption" TEXT NULL, "taken_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_pulled_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_issues" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "message" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolved_at" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_files" ("media_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NULL, "thumb_path" TEXT NULL, "upload_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "download_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', PRIMARY KEY ("media_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "relation_cache" ("person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "path_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "term_en" TEXT NOT NULL, "term_hi" TEXT NOT NULL, "side" TEXT NOT NULL, "distance" INTEGER NOT NULL, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "via_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "graph_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("person_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kv_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX people_full_name_idx ON people (full_name)
CREATE INDEX people_updated_idx ON people (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX person_names_person_idx ON person_names (person_id)
CREATE INDEX person_contacts_person_idx ON person_contacts (person_id)
CREATE INDEX person_contacts_value_idx ON person_contacts (normalized_value)
CREATE INDEX person_addresses_person_idx ON person_addresses (person_id)
CREATE INDEX person_attributes_person_idx ON person_attributes (person_id)
CREATE INDEX parent_child_parent_idx ON parent_child (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX parent_child_child_idx ON parent_child (child_id)
CREATE INDEX partnerships_a_idx ON partnerships (person_a_id)
CREATE INDEX partnerships_b_idx ON partnerships (person_b_id)
CREATE INDEX social_person_idx ON social_connections (person_id)
CREATE INDEX social_other_idx ON social_connections (other_person_id)
CREATE INDEX family_members_group_idx ON family_group_members (family_group_id)
CREATE INDEX family_members_person_idx ON family_group_members (person_id)
CREATE INDEX person_tags_person_idx ON person_tags (person_id)
CREATE INDEX person_tags_tag_idx ON person_tags (tag_id)
CREATE INDEX interactions_date_idx ON interactions (occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX participants_interaction_idx ON interaction_participants (interaction_id)
CREATE INDEX participants_person_idx ON interaction_participants (person_id)
CREATE INDEX reminders_due_idx ON reminders (due_at)
CREATE INDEX media_person_idx ON media (person_id)
